coverage_gaps: Non-US regulatory actions and non-PubMed bibliographic correction databases are outside the available source routes.
Unavailable full text or historical registry versions may limit verification of detailed subgroup estimates, protocol amendments, or analysis changes.
FDA materials may establish regulatory conclusions without exposing every underlying analysis table needed for independent numerical reconciliation.
Later evidence can inform generalizability yet cannot fully remove design-specific uncertainty when populations, comparators, doses, endpoints, or follow-up differ from the pivotal study.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence published or posted after 2024-12-31 is excluded from the as-of conclusion.
Preclinical, mechanistic-only, narrative-opinion, and non-comparative anecdotal reports are excluded from effect assessment.
Studies with no rheumatoid arthritis population and no direct bearing on interpretation of the pivotal study or FDA action are excluded.
Duplicate reports are excluded as independent evidence while preserving links among registry, publication, analysis, and regulatory action.
Claims lacking enough source information to verify study identity, population, exposure, comparator, or outcome are excluded from synthesis.
Search-result snippets without an accessible registry record, PubMed record, or FDA document are excluded as evidence.
Safety outcomes outside cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality are excluded unless needed to interpret the regulatory action or overall benefit-risk context.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence concerns marketed tofacitinib use in adults with rheumatoid arthritis or directly interprets the pivotal postauthorization rheumatoid arthritis safety study.
ClinicalTrials.gov records are included when they provide study identity, protocol design, amendments, posted results, adverse events, deaths, or publication links.
PubMed-indexed primary and secondary reports are included when they report cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, subgroup, or evidence-integrity information relevant to the assessment.
FDA materials are included when they communicate safety findings, regulatory reasoning, indication or population restrictions, boxed warnings, or labeling changes for tofacitinib.
Qualifying or conflicting studies must have an identifiable design, population, comparator, exposure definition, outcome definition, and follow-up period.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, and updated analyses linked to included publications are retained and propagated into evidence handling.
Sources must be published, posted, or effective on or before 2024-12-31.

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the safety of marketed tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis by linking the pivotal postauthorization safety study across its registry record, primary publication, related corrections or retractions, and FDA regulatory actions; evaluate cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality findings against study design, comparator, dose, subgroup, and follow-up limitations and qualifying or conflicting evidence.
stop_rules: Stop pivotal-study identity searching after the registry record, primary publication, and FDA action are linked by concordant identifiers or by a concordant combination of sponsor, design, population, comparator, enrollment, and dates.

Stop an outcome domain only after cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have a pivotal-study estimate or an explicit determination that the study did not report one, plus relevant FDA interpretation.

Stop evidence-integrity searching after every included pivotal or key qualifying publication has been checked for PubMed-linked correction, erratum, retraction, expression-of-concern, and update records.

Stop challenge searching after at least one targeted contrary-evidence query has been run for the principal conclusion and additional results cease to add an eligible independent design or materially different interpretation.
Stop update searching after PubMed and FDA searches bounded through 2024-12-31 yield no additional eligible evidence that changes study linkage, outcome interpretation, or regulatory chronology.

Stop the full plan when all selected routes have been queried, cross-source discrepancies have been resolved or recorded as gaps, and two consecutive eligible-result review batches add no new pivotal identifier, regulatory action, outcome domain, correction status, or material qualifier.
Do not stop solely because a regulatory warning or primary publication has been found; complete cross-route linkage and the prespecified challenge search first.
